providers.description: Favorite companies: fetch each URL in config/favorites.txt with tinyfish fetch_content and extract every posting from the rendered page. source field = 'careers_page'.

Dynamic search: run each query in config/searches.txt (append query_suffix) through tinyfish search; results that link to individual job postings are candidates. Log each query via db.py log-search. source field = 'tinyfish_search'.
Favorites whose careers URL matches boards.greenhouse.io: the board page lists all open roles with direct links; extraction is highly reliable. source field = 'greenhouse'.
Favorites whose careers URL matches jobs.lever.co: board page lists all roles. source field = 'lever'.
Favorites whose careers URL matches jobs.ashbyhq.com: board page lists all roles. source field = 'ashby'.

Public JSON API returning an array of jobs (fields: company, position, location, url, tags). Fetch entry_url once per scan, filter to postings matching the resume's stack. source field = 'remoteok'. Enable if you want remote roles.
YC startup jobs directory. Used by /discover-startups to find new companies; can also be scanned daily if enabled. source field = 'yc_directory'.
Wellfound (AngelList Talent). Often login-walled; enable only after verifying fetch_content can render listings. source field = 'wellfound'.

notes: To add a provider (LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, Cutshort, Hirist, ...): append an entry with a unique id, set kind to one of careers_page|search|ats_pattern|board_api|directory, and describe how to discover postings from it. Skills iterate enabled providers generically — no skill changes needed. To remove one, set enabled: false.
